previous_why: Card W43-RETURN-EXPRESSION measured 82 refused return leaves over 76 Unknown functions whose expression contains a call but is not one whole call: 53 with an uncontracted call in arithmetic or comparison (`strcmp(a, b) == 0`), 18 conditionals and 9 short-circuits over a call, and 2 whose calls are all contracted; 41 leaves (39 functions) are sole blockers. B01 already admits exactly one externally declared contracted `None` call in a scalar residual; everything else needs an evaluation model for a call whose result feeds further computation, and a conditional or short-circuit call is not unconditionally evaluated (constraint 5d). Discharge: a measured card that either lowers the refused-call subset to the classifier's refusal of the call with a proved frequency-preserving decomposition, or states per sub-shape why it stays refused.
appended: Re-measured by W45-RETURN-EXPRESSION-FAMILIES on the 2026-09-25 baseline: 79 leaves over 73 Unknown functions, 35 sole-blocked, unchanged by that card, which admits no call inside a larger return expression; 65 of them are in scalar-result functions, 14 in pointer-result ones (census/residual-sizing.txt of that report).

previous_why: Card W43-RETURN-EXPRESSION measured 290 refused return leaves over 264 Unknown functions whose expression carries no call: 186 read through a base the body may bind (constraint 5 / REACH-GATE-BOUND-BASE), 44 through a base whose declared type the reader will not commit to (e.g. `const cJSON * const item`, `UnreadableSpecifiers`), 31 end at an Unresolved member (typedef pointer members such as `cfl_sds_t`), 12 at an aggregate-valued (union) member, and 17 at other operand shapes; 75 are sole blockers (27 base-type, 22 unresolved member, 12 union member). None is a return-position question: each is an indirect-access, base-type-reader or member-typing premise shared with every other expression position, so this card deliberately does not widen it. Discharge: the general indirect-access and typed-member cards consume this per-obstacle split (it refines RETURN-POSITION-TYPED-MEMBER-REACH) and re-measure it at their arbiters.
appended: Narrowed by W45-RETURN-EXPRESSION-FAMILIES, which decides call-free reads in scalar-result functions without member typing (C converts the value to the declared scalar result): the family falls from 289 to 144 leaves over 130 Unknown functions, 27 sole-blocked (docs/reports/w45-return-expression-families/census/census-after.txt); the rest is the pointer-result half (W45-RETURN-POINTER-RESULT-READS) and bound-base positions (W45-RETURN-BOUND-BASE-POSITIONS).

previous_why: Card W43-RETURN-EXPRESSION measured 67 refused return leaves over 32 Unknown functions spelled `return (E1), E2;`, almost all nanopb's PB_RETURN_ERROR expansion `(stream->errmsg = stream->errmsg ? stream->errmsg : "..."), 0`; 2 are sole blockers. Two further call-free leaves carry a brace (statement expression or compound literal); the two whole calls whose argument is a compound literal were lowered to the classifier's `braced initializer` refusal. The comma operator itself is a sequence point, so `E1; return E2;` is an exact desugaring, but E1 is a pointer-member store through a base the body binds, which is indirect access outside this card and would only exchange the refusal. Discharge: a card that lands the sequential desugaring together with (or after) a sound pointer-member store rule, measured.
appended: Re-measured by W45-RETURN-EXPRESSION-FAMILIES: 69 leaves over 34 Unknown functions (1 sole-blocked), unchanged.

previous_why: Card W43-RETURN-EXPRESSION measured 26 call-free refused return leaves over 26 Unknown functions whose top-level operator is `?:` (18) or `&&`/`||` (8); 17 are sole blockers. `?`, `:` and the logical operators are already admitted operand punctuation, so these refuse for an operand (a bound base, an untyped member, a dereference), not for the operator. This updates RETURN-POSITION-CONDITIONAL's 28-leaf wave-33 population with the analyzer's own token view but does not answer its counterfactual question. Discharge: RETURN-POSITION-CONDITIONAL's measurement, per operand obstacle, at the next typed-access arbiter.
